cmd.convert_other.help.long:
Adopt a third-party (non-VEAF) .miz mission onto the v6 toolchain.

Extracts the mission, detects the scripts loaded by its native triggers, and scaffolds a mission.yaml with an ordered custom_scripts: block, the native loader triggers to strip, and all VEAF modules disabled (enable what you need). The counterpart of convert-v5, which migrates a VEAF v5 mission.

cmd.convert_other.opt.profile: Conversion profile tailoring the scaffold (bundled name, e.g. 'foothold', or a path to a .yaml profile). Without it, a generic 'minimal' scaffold is produced.
cmd.convert_other.opt.report_file: Save the conversion report to a Markdown file. Defaults to <output_folder>/convert-other-report.md.
cmd.convert_other.opt.update: Re-import a fresher upstream .miz into an already-adopted folder: refresh the third-party scripts and mission base, preserve the tuned mission.yaml, and report scripts added/removed/updated upstream.
cmd.convert_v5.help: Convert a v5-style VEAF mission folder to v6 format.
cmd.convert_v5.help.long:
Convert a v5-style VEAF mission folder to v6 format.

Runs all migration steps in a single pass:
 
1. Scans the mission folder for v5 artifacts (missionConfig.lua, pipeline config files such as presets.yaml, waypoints.yaml, …).
2. Migrates missionConfig.lua in-place: comments out doFile() calls that load VEAF scripts (the v6 builder injects them automatically), and wraps bare veafXxx.initialize() calls in ``if veafXxx then … end`` guards.
3. Generates mission.yaml with the correct lua_modules: and pipeline: sections derived from the analysis in steps 1 and 2.
4. Prints a detailed conversion report and optionally saves it as Markdown.

DCS trigger conversion (v5 → v6) is handled automatically by ``veaf-tools build`` — no manual action is required for that part.

convert_v5.migration_note.aircraft_group: Convert `{v5}` to v6 YAML (`src/templates.yaml`). The v6 schema uses `airplanes:` / `helicopters:` top-level keys with a flattened `coalitions > country > group` structure instead of `settings.categories.plane.coalitions.countries.groups`.
convert_v5.migration_note.presets: Convert `{v5}` to v6 YAML (`src/presets.yaml`). The v6 schema uses `radios_collection:` / `presets_collection:` / `presets_assignments:` instead of the flat v5 `presets_definition:` / `coalitions:` structure.
convert_v5.migration_note.waypoints: Convert `{v5}` to v6 YAML (`src/waypoints.yaml`). The overall structure (`waypoints:` + `settings:`) is similar but some field names changed.
convert_v5.migration_note.weather: Convert `{v5}` to v6 YAML (`src/versions.yaml`). Key renames: `lat/lon/tz` → `latitude/longitude/timezone`, `targets` → `versions`, `version` → `name`, `realweather: true` → `airport_icao: <ICAO>`, `weatherfile: x.lua` → inline `weather:` block.

smoke.block.no_dostring_in: net.dostring_in is not available in this hook environment, so nothing can reach the mission scripting state. ED gates it behind Saved Games/DCS/Config/autoexec.cfg: net.allow_unsafe_api = {"userhooks"} and net.allow_dostring_in = {"mission"}.
smoke.block.no_hook: no hook answered — DCS is not running, or dcs-fiddle-server.lua is not installed in Saved Games/DCS/Scripts/Hooks/.
smoke.block.no_mission_env: the mission environment did not answer, so there is nothing to assert against yet.
smoke.capabilities: What DCS reported it can do:
smoke.failure_is_a_measurement: A failure here is a measurement, not necessarily a defect — read the check's `why` in veaf_libs/dcs_smoke.py before concluding anything about the code.
smoke.probe.wrong_contract: the hook answered but returned {reply} instead of a table of facts — it is speaking a different contract, so treat every capability below as unknown rather than absent.
smoke.skip.no_dostring_in: net.dostring_in is not available in this hook environment, so nothing can reach the mission scripting state where the VEAF scripts live — and no assertion can run. ED gates it behind Saved Games/DCS/Config/autoexec.cfg: net.allow_unsafe_api = {"userhooks"} and net.allow_dostring_in = {"mission"}. See doc/developer/smoke-harness.md.
smoke.skip.no_hook: no DCS hook answered. Start DCS (the main menu is enough) with dcs-fiddle-server.lua in Saved Games/DCS/Scripts/Hooks/.
smoke.skip.no_mission: the hook answered but no mission is loaded, so there is nothing to assert against. Load a mission (see doc/developer/smoke-harness.md) and run this again. net.load_mission is {load_mission} for the follow-up that loads it automatically.
smoke.skip.no_scripting_route: a mission is running ({mission}) but nothing reached the Lua state the VEAF scripts live in, so every check would assert about the wrong environment. env=mission is the *trigger* state — it has no `env` table — and neither a_do_script nor net.dostring_in("scripting", …) got past it here. This is the finding, not a harness defect. What DCS said: {error}

updater.action.get_release: Fetching release for tag '{tag}' from GitHub
updater.cmd_help:
Downloads the latest VEAF Tools files from GitHub using Git tags.

This command fetches compiled tools and scripts from GitHub releases.
By default, it uses the 'published-latest' tag which always points to the most recent version.

For testing, use --zip-file to install from a local published.zip file instead of GitHub.

v5convert.presets.faithful_header:
presets.v5.yaml — faithful iso-functional copy of the v5 presets.
Generated by convert-v5 as a reference / rollback; NOT loaded by the build
(presets.yaml is). Raw frequencies kept as-is.
v5convert.presets.legacy_header:
presets.yaml — radio presets generated by convert-v5.
Auto-generated: do not edit by hand, re-run convert-v5 to regenerate.
v5convert.presets.plan_header:
presets.yaml — radio presets generated by convert-v5 (the plan).
Auto-generated: do not edit by hand, re-run convert-v5 to regenerate.

- channel_lists: the per-role channel lists the build projects automatically onto
  every aircraft's physical radios.
- channels_collection: resolves the named aliases (Guard, Gudauta…) to their
  frequencies. A frequency with no known alias is left as a raw number.
- presets_collection / presets_assignments: per-aircraft presets that override the
  plan when present.

Faithful iso-functional copy (reference / rollback, NOT loaded): {faithful}.

validate.config_override_target_missing: config_override: the target '{target}' is not among this mission's scripts. The override would be loaded last, after the setup script has already read the settings, so it would have no effect. Point target at a script listed in custom_scripts (or use the conversion profile matching this mission).
validate.config_override_unknown_segment: config_override: '{segment}' (in key '{override_key}') is found nowhere in the injected mission scripts — a typo or an upstream rename. Fix the key or update config_override.
validate.custom_script_missing: custom_scripts: declared script '{path}' does not exist.
validate.incompatible_module: modules: '{module}' is incompatible with the '{profile}' conversion profile and must stay disabled.
validate.missing_group: Group '{group}' declared in {section} is absent from the mission — place it in the Mission Editor, or the feature fails at runtime.
validate.missing_trigger_zone: Trigger zone '{zone}' referenced by {section} does not exist in the mission — create it in the Mission Editor.
validate.missing_trigger_zone_optional: Trigger zone '{zone}' referenced by {section} does not exist in the mission — the configured center/radius will be used instead. Remove trigger_zone_name to silence this.
validate.missing_unit: Unit '{unit}' referenced by {section} is absent from the mission — place it in the Mission Editor, or the zone polygon is incomplete.
validate.no_source_mission: Source mission table (src/mission/mission) not found — skipping the group / preset / waypoint / TUM checks.
validate.source_mission_unreadable: Source mission table (src/mission/mission) exists but could not be parsed: {error} — the group / preset / waypoint / TUM checks were skipped.
validate.presets_no_aircraft: presets.yaml is configured but the mission has no player aircraft to apply radio presets to.
validate.radio_lua_function_missing: Radio menu: referenced Lua function '{function}' is not defined in the mission scripts (define it in mission-script.lua).
validate.radio_menu_missing_target: Radio menu: action '{action}' of command '{command}' requires parameter '{param}'.
validate.radio_menu_unknown_action: Radio menu: unknown action '{action}' for command '{command}'.
validate.tum_zones_missing: TUM is enabled but no {sides} territory trigger zone was found — TheUniversalMission aborts at start-up without them.
validate.undeclared_subzone: Sub-zone '{subzone}' referenced by {section} is not declared as a combat_zones entry — the operation cannot resolve it at runtime.
validate.unknown_airfield: Airfield '{airfield}' referenced by {section} is unknown on this theatre — check the spelling against the Mission Editor airfield name.
validate.waypoints_no_aircraft: waypoints.yaml is configured but the mission has no aircraft groups to inject waypoints into.

yaml.error.context: The error starts near line {line}, column {col}.
yaml.error.hint.colon:
→ A key is probably missing its colon ':' separator.
    Every YAML key must be written as:  key: value
yaml.error.hint.generic:
→ Open the file in a text editor and check the structure near the indicated line.
    Make sure all indentation uses spaces (not tabs).
yaml.error.hint.indentation:
→ Check the indentation around these lines. YAML uses spaces only (never tabs).
    All items in the same block must be aligned at the same column.
yaml.error.hint.tab:
→ YAML does not allow tab characters for indentation.
    Replace all tabs with spaces in your text editor.
yaml.semantic.bad_enabled: mission.yaml: module '{module}': 'enabled' must be true or false (got {type}).
yaml.semantic.bad_loglevel: mission.yaml: module '{module}': 'logLevel' must be a string (got {type}).
yaml.semantic.bad_settings: mission.yaml: module '{module}': 'settings' must be a mapping of key: value pairs (got {type}).
yaml.semantic.ctld_settings_removed: modules.{module}: `settings:` is no longer read — CTLD 2 is configured in ctld-config.yaml, next to mission.yaml (edit it with ctld-tools). Remove the settings: block.
yaml.semantic.removed_section: mission.yaml: the '{section}:' section no longer exists — move its content under the matching module in the 'modules:' block (SKYNET / CTLD / CSAR / QRA).
yaml.semantic.unknown_init_param: mission.yaml: module '{module}': unrecognized init parameter '{param}' — it will be ignored.
yaml.semantic.unknown_module: mission.yaml: unknown module '{module}' in 'modules:' — check the spelling against the documented module list.
yaml.semantic.wrong_type: mission.yaml: module '{module}' must be a boolean, empty, or a mapping (got {type}).
yaml.syntax.empty_value: # Empty value (mandatory modules): MODULE:   (nothing after the colon)
yaml.syntax.indentation: # Indentation: spaces only (never tabs). Each level = 2 spaces.
yaml.syntax.lists: # Lists: each item on its own line, preceded by  -
yaml.syntax.multiline: # Multiline text: use  |  (literal block) — each continuation line indented by 2 extra spaces.
yaml.syntax.quotes: # Quotes: only needed when a value contains  :  #  {  [  or starts with a digit.
yaml.syntax.quotes_escapes: #   Also required when the value contains escape sequences such as  \n  \t
